gates.title: One command builds the disk image from a clean tree
gates.detail: clean build in 27 s wrote build/inti.img (2,097,152 bytes)

gates.title: Boots from its own boot sector to a shell prompt in QEMU within 20 s
gates.detail: shell prompt 269 ms after QEMU started; the image begins with Inti's own boot sector (signature 55 AA); no multiboot header and no GRUB in boot sector or kernel

gates.title: The self-test inside the system passes with at least 30 checks
gates.detail: SELFTEST: PASS 96/96 after boot and 96/96 again after every injected fault and the fuzz run, none skipped, with W^X enforced (QEMU -cpu qemu32,+nx)

gates.title: Each supervised service is crashed and hung, restarted automatically, and timed
gates.detail: console crash 8.6 ms, fs crash 4.9 ms, console hang 712.3 ms, fs hang 715.3 ms, fs crash during a console hang: fs 39.9 ms and console 625.6 ms (median of 5 runs each, guest clock); the shell answered after every run

gates.title: Every attempt of the hostile program without capabilities is denied
gates.detail: 51/51 attempts denied (including port I/O 3, interrupts 5, physical memory 1, kernel memory 4, other tasks 2, forged capabilities 4, forged tokens 1); the kernel invariants hold and the shell still answers

gates.title: At least 1,000,000 random system calls: no kernel panic, no invariant violated
gates.detail: 1,000,789 random system calls from 2,063 tasks, 4,307 invariant checks, 0 violations, 0 kernel anomalies, no kernel panic in the serial log

gates.title: No heap in the kernel, every unsafe justified, at most 4,000 lines of kernel code
gates.detail: no alloc crate in the kernel; 87 uses of unsafe in kernel, boot sector and programs, each with a SAFETY comment; 2,933 lines of kernel code (limit 4,000)

gates.title: The same disk image boots to the shell prompt in a web browser
gates.detail: shell prompt after 2.45 s in v86 0.5.473 (WebAssembly) under chromium 157.0.4341.46 (headless); 7 commands answered; byte-for-byte the image of the QEMU test

gates.title: Every number in the documents comes from a script or carries a source
gates.detail: tools/check_claims.py passes: claims recomputed, documents re-rendered and compared
